teacher_info.about_teacher: Hi! I am a Spanish and English certified teacher from Argentina. I have been a teacher for 25 years. I’ve worked with kids, teenagers and adults. I speak “español rioplatense” which is the Spanish spoken in Argentina and Uruguay. I consider myself a teacher focused on people. To me, the most important thing is that I tailored my lessons to cater to every single student I have. We all learn in different ways and at different paces. I am very patient and respectful. I am also very interested in knowing how you feel and whether the lessons work for you. Timely feedback is essential. Learning a language should be a pleasant experience and I work hard to deliver that!
teacher_info.teaching_style: I like to design lessons where the student is the center. Students should always speak more than the teacher! I prefer to teach from a communicative approach, which means that we learn very hands-on by doing. I tend to have a book to organize the contents and grammar points, but I always add more resources that connect with the students’ needs and styles, with the aim of making the whole experience meaningful and engaging. Like I said before, teaching and learning are like a two-way street that can be improved with feedback and clear goals. I devote a lot of time to designing my lessons for which I use various materials and resources.

Hello, how are you?
If you read this text, then you are interested in Armenian, one of the world's oldest languages. If you also love the Armenian language, let's work together. 
I studied at Gavar State University (Armenia), Faculty of Philology, with specialization in “Philologist, Teacher of Armenian Language and Literature” (http://www.gsu.am/?lang=ru). 
I am a professional Armenian teacher with extensive work experience, but every time I meet a new student, I open the treasure trove that is the Armenian language and once again discover that wonderful world in a new way.
